clips.title: The story
paras: In Thunder Bluff, Cairne Bloodhoof rules with hard-won wisdom. The venerable High Chieftain leads the united tauren tribes, and bound their fate to Thrall’s Horde after the orcs helped them escape extinction at centaur hands.

Cairne Bloodhoof led the tauren from a life of flight to a home in Mulgore. For generations, centaur marauders hunted the wandering tribes across the Barrens and drove them toward extinction. When Thrall and his orcs reached Kalimdor, Cairne saw a rare nobility in them. Thrall offered military protection and an escort for Cairne’s desperate caravan across the plains, in return for guidance to the Oracle at Stonetalon Peak. The tauren settled on Thunder Bluff’s towering mesas, where Cairne united the tribes and gave them a permanent home.

Cairne Bloodhoof fought beside Thrall’s Horde and Jaina Proudmoore’s humans against the Burning Legion during the Third War. Grateful to Thrall, he had followed the orcs to Stonetalon Peak. When Admiral Daelin Proudmoore invaded Durotar, Cairne took up arms again and fought alongside Rexxar after his captured son, Baine, was safely recovered. Now one of the Horde’s most respected elders, Cairne remains Thrall’s closest confidant and offers calm counsel against reckless warmongering.
